scenario: [LGRA.9.6.2]: `.shout` names no member of `String`, so the compiler refuses it with DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_MEMBER. The receiver `r.name` is a valid String slot read, so the refusal is about the member, not the slot.
rules_ds:
schema R scope logical:
    k: Int key
    name: String mutable

rule check:
    R r where r.name.shout == "A"
->
    log info "x"
